speaker: alse_pinder
text: The basin is where I said. Cold. The cloth is the coarse one. I am not heating water for a smear.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cold is what I asked for. The ear first. I would rather come to the table with my own face than with a story about how the paint got there.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I can hear the water. I am not coming into the passage to inspect an ear. Supper is on the board when you are a person again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am nearly a person. The coat is on the peg. The stitch can dry where it is. I am not bringing the pot in with the coat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The bundle is still where you left it. I looked once, this morning's look, and I am not looking again for a man who is only washing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not look again. Wipe is enough. I will sit when my hands are a lodger's hands.
